title: Flowise unauthenticated text-to-speech endpoint abuses private chatflow TTS credentials (GHSA-8gj2-2cvc-6xx7)
summary: Flowise 3.1.3 and earlier expose a text-to-speech endpoint without authorization checks, letting unauthenticated callers consume the TTS credentials configured on private chatflows. Fixed in 3.1.4 (note: one release later than the 3.1.3 batch).
